updates.name: Sabrina Prescott

updates.name: Rebecca Spurlock
updates.goal: Honestly, I love all music. I want to learn to sight read and maybe even one day play by ear in the distant fear future. I want to be able to sing to the best of my ability. And I want to be able to feel the music in my soul.

updates.name: Richard handy
updates.goal: I want to be able to express and share my heart through the piano. To get out of the way and just be moved. I want to be able to play Beethoven and do it while reciting poetry. My ultimate goals is to be able to channel Beethoven. If singing is a part of this I want to also share my heart through my voice. It is where I’ve experienced the most resistance in my craft as an actor/dancer.

updates.name: Yvonne Lui
updates.goal: accompanying herself and compose songs.

updates.name: Stephen D Eddy

updates.name: Mark Frost

updates.name: Scott Dutcher
updates.concern: I am so new to it really, for me it was the idea that I could never get my fingers/hands to work independently. I do have a good ear and can sound out tunes on the keyboard, I have come up with a couple of my own melodies/songs when I get inspired, but never really take the time to develop them because I feel like I don't have the tools or skills currently, hence me wanting to learn.

updates.name: Michael R Buley

updates.name: Ana Sierra
updates.goal: To be able to play & create music. I would like to understand from a professional view point and share experience of being in a music environment. Also it helps me to become more discipline and stay on task on goal of learning to play piano and develop music skills.

updates.name: Belinda Jayne French
updates.goal:
To relax and make up some tunes
To beable to read music to play simple tunes and
make up songs for my Save Soil workshops. Have fun with friends and children at school

updates.goal: I would love to be able to create and play my own or others' music in a way that moves people.

updates.name: Dawn Hamer

updates.name: Deeanne Saunders

updates.name: Rob marvenko

updates.name: Stephanie Fountaine
updates.goal:
To be fully self expressed and expand my knowledge and confidence as a musician. And to share my gift with others.

How would this benefit your life?: I would feel more at ease and confident as a pianist and be able to also expand my teaching and performance opportunities. I would be more inclined to promote myself more as an artist not just a teacher or accompanist.

updates.name: Han Do
updates.goal: To be able to play any songs that I would like.

updates.name: Melanie Passwater
updates.goal: The ability to play confidently and accurately for others, release stress through composing and playing whatever comes from my heart.

updates.name: Iva Harris
updates.goal: I want to receive from this program basic piano knowledge and skills that will propel me to an advance level so that I am able to accompany myself professionally while singing and playing  for others at chruch and civic functions, sorority functions, family gatherings, etc.

updates.name: Matt Sawtell
updates.concern: Wants his playing to be more flamboyant.
updates.goal: Singing and playing at the same time and expanding his piano abilities.

updates.name: RF Doran
updates.goal: same as concern

updates.name: Brett Stark
updates.concern: putting all the components together with reading music.
updates.goal: Proficient at fingering and playing with two hands at performance speed.

updates.name: Dvora Cope
updates.concern: Not being confident that I can do this and Fear of failure and fear of taking risks and not believing in myself

updates.name: Joellen Bucher
updates.concern: I’ve been very busy with other things in my life. But now that I am mostly retired and my children are grown, I am free to do things for me. I also thought that playing piano consisted primarily of playing notes. And my early experience with lessons wasn’t very positive. I felt as if I was forced to take lessons.
updates.goal: I’d like to be able to play confidently and with emotion, by just knowing what notes and chords to play. I want to be able to accompany other musicians. I know I need to practice reading notes and play pieces, but just playing without reading music has always intrigued me. There is a science behind this and I know if I continue in this program, I will be able to do just that. Finally, I want to be able to sing!

updates.name: Paul Marriage
updates.goal: To be able to play the blues and boogie-woogie. To be able to take an existing piece of music and alter/embellish it. I guess that's a sort of improvisation. To play by ear. When I watch my son play the piano, it's as if he and the piano become a single entity. He gets carried away by the music, and it's beautiful. I want some of that!

updates.name: Stephen Jeffrey King
updates.concern: Playing chords in a timely manner
updates.goal: Be proficient in piano and possibly perform

updates.name: Tao Ye
updates.concern: Do not like learning under stress
updates.goal: Love to play in confidence and can able to express myself in playing

updates.name: Zola Bertram
updates.goal: Well, I would love to be able to play at least intermediate levels of piano arrangements flawlessly and with confidence. To watch Stephen play is such an inspiration- to play with just a fraction of his joy and enthusiasm would be one of the greatest gifts I could give myself.

updates.name: Patricia Larkin
updates.goal: I want to be a good piano player not a perfect one.  There are so many beautiful music scores.  I could listen to them but how much more beauty if I could play them.

updates.name: Susan OCrowley OCrowley
updates.goal: Fast note/chord recognition from C2-C6 so I could sit down and play more difficult music. Quicker fingers. Also, To learn the piano well enough to just sit down and play freely without sheet music. To learn more about composing music. To improve my singing. To learn how to teach music better. To just enjoy playing for myself. To know how to play some of my favorite songs without sheet music. To move others with the music I play. To make people laugh, tear up, dance, etc. To be good enough to be a confident accompaniest.

updates.name: Per Gunnarsson
updates.concern: wants to be a better piano player.

updates.name: Hugo Samuel
updates.goal: Besides learning how to read and write music I would love to be able to perform in front of people. I would love to learn how to sing better besides in the car. I want to show everyone that I still have talent and that I still love music. And maybe even inspire someone or teach them how to play piano. To pass the torch as one would say. But mostly to be able to perform in crowds

updates.name: Mary Bucklin
updates.concern: I can sing the songs, but I want to be able to play the piano and jazz it up or make it bluesier or fill out the accompaniment--play it my way since I may not be a good enough reader to play it the way it's written.
updates.goal: I want to learn how to improvise, so that I can take the "easy" arrangements and play them the way I want them to sound from a simple melody line..

updates.name: Linda Allison
updates.goal: To read music and play with confidence and joy for myself and others.

updates.name: Else Winther
updates.goal: better at accompanying herself. singing and playing at the same time proficiently.
